_why: English that stays English in every language. Read by scripts/i18n_audit.mjs. Components are anchored regexes over the top-level function a string sits in; strings are exact; patterns are regexes over the string. Every entry here is a decision, so say why in _notes.

_notes.Elo / Scout / SeasonReview: The Elo pages and team scouting are left English on purpose (Zaven, 2026-10-03): a Chicagoland tool for one English-speaking scene.
_notes.FAQView: How it works is translated WHOLE (i18n/src/faq/<lang>.html, baked as faqHtml); its English template is the source, not UI.
_notes.Admin: Admin- and allowlist-only screens (feedback inbox, Amazon stock check, calendar editor, graded-sale editing, tournament upload/edit, scout members) are only ever seen by the site's own admins.
_notes.Brands: Product and company names are not translated.
_notes.Legal: GradedTosModal is the graded-data licence terms: the binding text stays English, like a contract.
_notes.Patterns: ${l.label} is a language's own name in the language picker (日本語, Deutsch) and must never be translated; ${mapFocus.label} is a place name typed by the reader.
_notes.Data: SITE_LANGS = each language's own name; ELO_/RPH_ consts feed the English-only Elo pages; buildSearchSuggestions labels are search SYNTAX the reader types; deckToText writes an exported decklist other tools read; parseGradedTier/CUSTOM_CARDS are card and grade data.
